receiptUri.description: AT-URI of the purchase.receipt this consent record accompanies.

receiptCid.description: CID of the receipt at time of consent. Links consent to a specific, immutable receipt state.

licenseGrantUri.description: AT-URI of the license.terms record the buyer consented to.

licenseGrantCid.description: CID of the license.terms record at time of consent. The buyer agreed to these exact terms — not a future or past version.

buyerDid.description: DID of the buyer. Names the consenting party explicitly, making this a buyer-addressed instrument rather than an anonymous terms snapshot.

consentedAt.description: Timestamp of affirmative consent. Combined with the PDS record's creation timestamp forms a tamper-evident assertion of when consent was given.

appSig.description: Base64url signature by the app service keypair over SHA-256(buyerDid:licenseGrantCid:receiptCid:consentedAt). Prevents consent records being fabricated outside the app's trust boundary.

usageTier.description: The license tier the buyer selected at checkout. Surfaces the buyer's affirmative acknowledgment of which tier applies — redundant with the license.terms tier field but records the buyer's explicit selection.

syncProject.description: For sync tier only. Human-readable description of the project this license covers, e.g. 'Short film: The Last Train, dir. A. Smith, 2026'. Optional but strongly recommended for sync purchases.
